spans.s: अध्रि [adhri], a. [न-धृ-कि] Not restrained, irresistible. _Comp. -गु-गू a. [अध्रि-गम्-कू -डित् ऊङादेशो वा] of irresistible motion or course (अधृतगमन), impetuous; यदभ्रिगावो अंध्रिगू इदा चिदह्नो अश्विना
. (-गुः N. of a heavenly killer of sacrificial victims, or the name formula itself ending with an invocation of Agni. -ज a. [अध्रिं जनयति, जन्-ड] making irresistible.
Not held, not to be got hold of; not forthcoming.
Unsteady, moving, not fixed or permanent; स्वाङ्गे$ध्रुवे

; separable (which can be severed or detached without fatal or disastrous effects) (येन विना न जीवनं सो$ध्रुवः Sk.)-वम् An uncertainty; यो ध्रुवाणि परित्यज्य अध्रुवाणि निषेवते । ध्रुवाणि तस्य नश्यन्ति अध्रुवं नष्टमेव च
. cf. the English phrase 'A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.'
अध्रुषः [adhruṣḥ], Quinsy; a kind of disease attended with fever arising from the affection of blood; शोथः स्थूलस्तो- ददाहप्रकाशो रक्ताज्ज्ञेयः सो$ध्रुषो रुग्ज्वराढ्यः Suśr. (Mar. गळसटें, घटसर्प.)
आध्र [ādhra], a. Ved. [आ-धृ-क] Poor, indigent, weak. -ध्रः Support.
